lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the lateral flank, organized into roughly 5-6 horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits and anterior to the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-reflecting upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the basal and central regions of the fin's visible surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, distinct white pixel clusters that appear more randomized and smaller in diameter compared to the primary flank constellation.
